A.text: Lever A's ₹10 lakh of extra performance ads is counted once, as growth money in the month spent, and is not added again to the performance-ads fixed spend
A.basis: C-E6H3 says count each growth item once

A.text: Each channel's fixed spend (₹99 lakh in all) stays as today in every plan and every month
A.basis: No lever in Exhibit 6 changes it

A.text: Commission, coupons and every per-phone cost apply only to delivered orders; an order that cannot be delivered earns and costs nothing
Rationing includes trade in orders: Superb first, pro rata across all channels, then all orders pro rata to the lab limit
Return-rate cuts from B1 and B2 multiply each channel's own rate, including the website rate that trade in buyers pay
A.basis: C-E6H2: multiply effects on return rates

A.text: The 15% trade in failure rate applies equally to each arriving grade
30% of all trade ins, failed or passed, also buy a Tikau phone
A.basis: C-E6TI4: 30% of people who trade in

A.text: From February the Superb rule (85% or more) is applied to Tikau's own lab reading; with no failure rate in the case, no Superb phone changes grade
A.basis: C-E5a, C-E6B1; no data on Superb readings

A.text: January is today's month in every plan, so doing nothing earns today's result in each of the three months
A third shift adds 1,800 sellable phones, so the limit becomes 9,000; its ₹9 lakh is growth money in each month it runs
B2's 4% price rise raises MegaKart's 12% commission on those phones, because the commission is a share of the selling price
The ₹120 report cost and the B2 battery costs apply to trade in buyers' phones too
A.basis: C-E6H2: cost changes apply to every phone sold

A.text: Weekly figures use 4.33 weeks a month
The November spot check (22 of 200 Good phones below 80%) applies to all Good phones sold, so about 351 a month carry an untrue battery claim today
In April Tikau has new growth money for the next quarter and the trade in ramp restarts at 1,000, then 1,800, then 800 more a month to 4,000
A.basis: C-E6TI1 pattern; April is outside the board tests

A.text: Stress tests move only what Tikau does not control (the order rise, the return cut, battery shares, claim rates) 25% worse or better; prices and the ₹120 report cost are Tikau's decisions and stay as printed; the plan uses the printed values
A.basis: Team convention for Q5 trigger levels

A.text: Revenue in the reconciliation is gross selling price before commission; the case's ₹139 crore is read as that figure
Month figures are averages of August to October 2026 and stand for November 2026 to January 2027 as well
Store, creator and MegaKart return multipliers stay as today when B1 and B2 apply
Trade in savings count only for traded phones that pass the check; a failed traded phone is sold as parts at cost, like a failed lab phone
